\tabnotes{Trend inflation \eqref{eq:trendinf} rebuilt from the same core-CPI
  series under every combination of the decay $v\in\{0.900,0.987,0.995\}$ and
  the window $M\in\{60,120,180\}$ months, then pushed through the full factor
  chain. $^{\dagger}$\,marks the baseline of \citet{cieslak2015}. ``Corr.\ with
  baseline'' reports the mean per-country correlation of the variant trend
  ($\pi^{e}$) and local factor ($\CF$) with their baseline counterparts, and the
  correlation of the global factors ($\GCF$). ``$R^{2}$ (in-sample)'' is the
  cross-country mean single-factor fit of $\rxbar_{i,t+12}$ on the variant
  factor, and $t(\GCF)$ the pooled fixed-effects Newey--West $t$ on the global
  factor. ``$R^{2}_{\mathrm{oos}}$'' is the pooled \citet{campbellthompson2008}
  statistic \eqref{eq:meth-ctr2} of the fully-recursive variant chain
  (expanding window, five-year training minimum) against the recursive
  prevailing mean. The core-CPI history begins early enough that every
  variant's trend predates the yield sample, so all cells share the same 412
  forecast-origin months.}
